[[File:Fable_Astin_training_SWJ8.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Fable Astin practicing cadences with Adalric Cessius Brandl on Trulalis.]]
{{Quote|I made it to the second cadence!|Fable Astin|<ref name="UEK">{{JournalCite|8|Uhl Eharl Khoehng (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''Cadences''' were practice techniques used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to hone their skills with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> The famed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vo'ren Faalo/Legends|Vo'ren Faalo]] developed a technique known as [[Faalo's cadences]],<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> which he described in the seven volume of his ''[[Book of Practical Lightsaber Technique]]''.<ref name="GG9" /> Another technique known as [[Sevinte cadence|''sevinte'' cadence]] was taught to [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] before they could wield a real [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

While [[Fable Astin/Legends|Fable Astin]] was training with [[Adalric Cessius Brandl]] on [[Trulalis]], her first lesson consisted of a series of cadences in which one manipulated small ball bearings placed atop tall candle wicks, and Astin initially excelled at the exercise. Unfortunately, when Adalric upped the difficulty level, Astin faltered and was unable to perform the exercise. Adalric became furious with Astin, ridiculing her for her weaknesses and inability to perform up to his standards.<ref name="UEK" />

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cadences were first mentioned in the ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'', published by [[West End Games]]<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> on [[May 13]], [[1993]].<ref name="BN">{{BN|url=w/star-wars-the-roleplaying-game-west-end-games-incorporated/1018175932|text=Star Wars the Roleplaying Game: Galaxy Guide #9: Fragments from the Rim}}</ref>
